description:
TourbillionSG is a team from Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: two AI engineers, two data analysts and two full-stack developers. Our name stands for S (space), G (gravity) and SG (Saigon). A tourbillon is a watch mechanism built to cancel the effect of gravity, and we want to study what fire does when gravity is gone.

Why join us: we have a clear plan, defined roles for each person, and a strict rule that every number must come from a cited source.
